Product.title: Product
Product.description: Sneaker product stored in user-scoped inventory with soft-delete tombstone and sync metadata.

id.description: Stable UUID matching the Firestore document ID.

description.description: Sneaker details such as brand, colorway, and size (0 to 500 characters).

priceCop.description: Price in Colombian Pesos (strictly positive integer).

updatedAt.description: Last local modification timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

isDeleted.description: Soft-delete tombstone flag for Room/Firestore synchronization.

/users/{uid}/products/{productId}.description: User-scoped sneaker inventory collection synchronized with local Room persistence.
